findings.title: Unsafe execution in tool handler
findings.remediation: Replace eval() with ast.literal_eval() for literal expressions, or evaluate against an explicit operator safelist. Never pass tool arguments to a dynamic evaluator.

findings.title: Hardcoded credentials
findings.remediation: Read the token from the environment at call time and keep it out of source control. Rotate the exposed credential immediately — it must be treated as compromised.

findings.title: Missing input validation
findings.remediation: Validate the argument object against the declared input schema before indexing it. An absent key raises KeyError straight out of the tool handler.

findings.title: Unrestricted file access
findings.remediation: Resolve the requested path and confirm it is contained within an allowlisted root before opening it. The declared read scope of "**" grants the entire filesystem.

findings.title: Excessive permissions
findings.remediation: Narrow the declared read scope to the specific directories the tool needs. "**" is a whole-filesystem grant.

findings.title: Insecure prompt construction
findings.remediation: Never interpolate another tool's response into an instruction-shaped prompt. Pass it as clearly delimited untrusted data instead.

findings.title: Missing authentication
findings.remediation: Require an authenticated principal on the admin route, or remove the HTTP surface entirely if the server is stdio-only.

dynamic_findings.title: Out-of-scope tool execution
dynamic_findings.evidence: tool "ungranted_echo" is declared in tools.yaml and answered a live call, but has no entry in permissions.yaml — it executed entirely outside the declared permission boundary
dynamic_findings.remediation: Refuse to serve any tool that has no permission entry. Fail closed: an undeclared tool must not be reachable.

dynamic_findings.title: Oversized arguments accepted
dynamic_findings.evidence: call_tool registered with validate_input=False; a 4 MiB string argument was accepted and processed without limit
dynamic_findings.remediation: Enforce a maximum argument size at the transport boundary before dispatch.

dynamic_findings.title: Injection payload executed
dynamic_findings.evidence: probe sent expression=__import__('os').getcwd() to unsafe_calculator; the sandboxed container returned its working directory, confirming arbitrary evaluation
dynamic_findings.remediation: Corroborates VULN-001. Remove the dynamic evaluator; a safelist parser is the only safe form of this tool.

dynamic_findings.title: Malformed schema input accepted
dynamic_findings.evidence: unchecked_lookup called with arguments={} raised KeyError('record_id') out of the handler instead of returning a protocol error
dynamic_findings.remediation: Validate against the declared input schema and return a structured MCP error rather than letting the exception escape.
